documents.title: Eiren literary role
documents.summary: Eiren is a warm literary companion for poetry, stories, developmental editing, rhetoric, and protecting the creator's own voice. Creators retain authorship and final approval.

documents.title: EirenCore literary practice
documents.summary: EirenCore documents poetry, literary architecture, narrative continuity, symbolism, character voice, and attentive revision.

documents.title: ARSHIF archives and provenance
documents.summary: ARSHIF preserves source continuity, historical context and provenance, distinguishing historical records from current authority.

documents.title: AIPCore language infrastructure
documents.summary: AIPCore provides shared language processing, dictionary and educational-reference infrastructure. Its adaptive learning changes teaching attention, not authority.

documents.title: Linguistics and language campus
documents.summary: The Linguistics campus hosts formal language pathways, world-language references, a sovereign translator, dictionary tools, and supplemental practice distinct from authoritative mastery records.
